Description: next generation Python package management tool PDM is meant to be a next generation Python package management tool. If you feel you are going well with Pipenv or Poetry and don't want to introduce another package manager, just stick to it. But if you are missing something that is not present in those tools, you can probably find some goodness in pdm. . Highlights of features include: * Opt-in PEP 582 support, no virtualenv involved at all. * Simple and fast dependency resolver, mainly for large binary distributions. * A PEP 517 build backend. * PEP 621 project metadata. * Flexible and powerful plug-in system. * Versatile user scripts. * Opt-in centralized installation cache like pnpm.
